subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Should this PR require a redacted live FAL or representative external proxy/TLS/private-endpoint run before merge, or is the controlled localhost provider-path proof sufficient for this security-sensitive routing change?
rationale: The implementation has no concrete correctness defect, but deciding whether localhost proof sufficiently covers an explicit private-network and transport-policy boundary requires maintainer risk tolerance.

options.title: Require external transport proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted run demonstrates the exact head through live FAL or a representative external proxy, TLS, or private-endpoint route.

options.title: Accept controlled provider proof
options.body: Waive the external-route requirement because the normal FAL provider path, shared resolver contract, focused tests, and localhost private-network request were already exercised.

recommendation.title: Require external transport proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted run demonstrates the exact head through live FAL or a representative external proxy, TLS, or private-endpoint route.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior work established the FAL SSRF guard and configured-relay trust boundary directly affected by this decision.
